basic_details.job_title: GMC Gondia Faculty Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 16 Professor, Associate Professor Posts
basic_details.short_information: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

age_limit.age_details: Maximum 69 years (at the time of appointment)

qualification.education_qualification: M.D./M.S./DNB in the concerned subject, with teaching experience, research publications and the basic course in biomedical research as per the NMC Notification dated 30.06.2025

salary_details.pay_scale: Professor Rs.2,00,000 and Associate Professor Rs.1,85,000 consolidated with all allowances for non-retired candidates; retired teachers as per Government rules

exam_pattern.details: Minimum 41% marks required in interview/verification to be considered for selection.

how_to_apply: Advertisement and application form are available on www.gmcgondya.in and www.med-edu.in from 20-11-2026.
Submit the application in the prescribed format to the office of Government Medical College, Gondia during government office hours, excluding government holidays.
Last date to submit is 30-11-2026, till 04.00 in the evening.
Do not attach any recommendation letter.
Produce original documents at the time of interview.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for GMC Gondia Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 30 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in GMC Gondia Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 16 vacancies: 1 Professor (Physiology), 1 Professor (Biochemistry), 1 Professor (Pathology), 1 Professor (PSM), 1 Professor (Pharmacology), 1 Professor (Respiratory Medicine) and 9 more posts.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for GMC Gondia Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Prescribed format available on www.gmcgondya.in and www.med-edu.in) and send it to Government Medical College, Gondia, Kunwar Tilaksingh General Hospital Campus, Nehru Chowk, Gondia, Maharashtra, by application submitted to the college office during government office hours, to reach by 30 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 69 years (at the time of appointment).

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Rs.2,00,000 (consolidated, including all allowances) for non-retired Professors; retired teachers as per Government rules for Professor (Physiology), Rs.2,00,000 (consolidated, including all allowances) for non-retired Professors; retired teachers as per Government rules for Professor (Biochemistry), Rs.2,00,000 (consolidated, including all allowances) for non-retired Professors; retired teachers as per Government rules for Professor (Pathology), Rs.2,00,000 (consolidated, including all allowances) for non-retired Professors; retired teachers as per Government rules for Professor (PSM), Rs.2,00,000 (consolidated, including all allowances) for non-retired Professors; retired teachers as per Government rules for Professor (Pharmacology).

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: M.D./M.S./DNB in the concerned subject, with teaching experience, research publications and the basic course in biomedical research as per the NMC Notification dated 30.06.2025. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidate must be a citizen of India and a resident of Maharashtra. Retired teachers of these posts and non-retired candidates of any age group from private or other sectors holding NMC-prescribed qualifications are eligible.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates who attach a recommendation letter or get recommended through other means will be disqualified. Candidates who put direct or indirect pressure on the selection committee will be excluded from selection.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Provisional merit list on 85 marks (items 1 to 4 of Annexure-A). Document verification and interview. Minimum 41 percent of 100 marks required for contract appointment. Provisional merit list based on a total of 85 marks for items 1 to 4 of Annexure-A.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Contract until a regular candidate is available or 364 days, whichever is earlier. Commissioner may change the posting of the contract candidate when a regular candidate becomes available. Appointment may be terminated without notice for unsatisfactory work, serious irregularity or misconduct.
